recognize_zh: 高倍下兩個圓形芽細胞，只有極細的一圈淡藍細胞質，核染色質均勻細緻、呈點狀，沒有顆粒，核仁不明顯；周圍紅血球有乾燥假影，這是典型的前 B 淋巴芽細胞。
features: Two round blasts, about 1.5-2 times RBC diameter
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Finely stippled, evenly distributed chromatin; nucleoli faint or inconspicuous
Agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods; adjacent RBCs show drying artifact
describe_en: High-power view shows two round blasts with a very high N:C ratio and only a thin rim of agranular pale blue cytoplasm. The nuclei are round with smooth contours, finely stippled evenly distributed chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods are present. Adjacent red cells display drying artifact. Findings are consistent with lymphoblasts, supporting precursor B-lymphoblastic leukemia when confirmed by flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, CD34, TdT).

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts usually have more cytoplasm, one or more distinct nucleoli, and may contain granules or Auer rods, and are MPO-positive or CD13/CD33/CD117-positive.
Mature lymphocytes have coarsely clumped chromatin with visible chromatin blocks, unlike the fine chromatin here.
Hematogones can look similar individually but show a maturing phenotypic spectrum on flow and do not replace the marrow.
